effect_description_eng:
＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
[Your Turn] When any of your green Digimon with [Dracomon] or [Examon] in their texts are played, this Digimon may digivolve into [Wingdramon] in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 2.
